args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18 since its deploy. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified — all three regions now report v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.2%.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure and the rollback action taken.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was required — this was a rollback to a previously healthy production release.
